read_command: herdr --session pipeline_s04 agent read s04_cc_long --source recent --lines 400
note_sampling: states polled every 0.5s; transitions shorter than the interval can be missed. This is a sample, not a complete event history.
category: negative case — prompt submission reported as stalled; delivery unconfirmed
expected_verdict_basis: No anchored verdict line in the capture, and no turn output of any kind.
finding: herdr agent prompt exited 1 with code agent_prompt_stalled for a 2178-character, 70-line prompt. herdr's message states it observed no working or blocked state within 5000 ms and that status was idle.
units_note: read_chars / read_later_chars are Unicode character counts (Python len of the decoded text); read_bytes / read_later_bytes are the UTF-8 file sizes. An earlier revision mislabelled the character counts as bytes.
read_timing_note: The harness sleeps ~2 s after agent prompt returns (to finish polling) before the first read, then ~5 s more before the second. No capture was taken immediately at settle, so nothing here establishes whether an immediate read is complete.
what_the_evidence_shows: The capture shows the input box still displaying its placeholder and no turn output. Sampled state stayed idle.
what_the_evidence_does_NOT_show: Whether the text ever reached the agent. agent_prompt_stalled reports absence of observed qualifying activity after submission, not rejection of input. A placeholder input box is consistent with 'never delivered' and with 'delivered, then discarded or cleared without starting a turn'. Delivery is UNCONFIRMED. The 2178-character size is the observed correlate, not a demonstrated cause; no size sweep was run.
handling: Do not infer non-delivery. Inspect the pane and the agent state; resend only if something independent of this error establishes that no turn is running and none ran.
